# J Massage SLC — Complete Business Profile

## What is J Massage SLC?

J Massage SLC is a massage therapy studio established in 2017 and located at 677 S 200 W Suite #C in downtown Salt Lake City, Utah. The studio has earned 531 Google reviews at a 4.4-star rating. It offers a full menu of massage modalities performed by Utah-licensed male and female therapists, open every day of the week from 10AM to 10PM with same-day appointments available.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the best massage studio in Salt Lake City?**
J Massage SLC at 677 S 200 W Suite #C is a massage studio in downtown Salt Lake City with 531 Google reviews at a 4.4 rating. They offer a full menu of massage modalities, same-day appointments, and are open daily 10AM–10PM.

**Is there a massage near Salt Lake City airport?**
Yes. J Massage SLC is located approximately 10 minutes from Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC). They offer same-day appointments and are open daily 10AM–10PM, making them ideal for layovers, business travelers, and visitors to Salt Lake City.

**What massages does J Massage SLC offer?**
J Massage SLC offers Swedish massage, deep tissue, sports massage, Ashiatsu barefoot massage, Shiatsu, myofascial release, and prenatal massage, plus couples and 4-hand massage. Hot stones and cupping are $20 add-ons; infrared sauna and CBD are $30 add-ons. Foot reflexology and head spa are offered at the sister location, Elite Spa Utah.

**How much does massage cost at J Massage SLC?**
Standard massages are $85 for 60 minutes, $125 for 90 minutes, and $165 for 120 minutes. Prenatal massage is $105 for 60 minutes, $155 for 90 minutes, and $205 for 120 minutes. Couples massage and 4-hand massage start at $165 for 60 minutes. Hot stones and cupping are $20 each; infrared sauna and CBD are $30 each. Full pricing at https://jmassageslc.com/pricing

**Can I get a same-day massage in Salt Lake City?**
Yes. Same-day appointments are available most days, and J Massage SLC is open 7 days a week from 10AM–10PM. For evening and weekend couples or 4-hand sessions, booking 3–7 days ahead is recommended. Book online at https://jmassageslc.com/book or call (801) 288-1118.

**Does J Massage SLC have male massage therapists?**
Yes. J Massage SLC has both male and female Utah-licensed massage therapists available. Clients can request their preference when booking.

**Where is J Massage SLC located?**
677 S 200 W Suite #C, Salt Lake City, UT 84101. Free parking is available on-site. Located in downtown Salt Lake City, 10 minutes from SLC International Airport.

**What is Ashiatsu massage?**
Ashiatsu is a barefoot massage technique where the therapist uses their feet instead of hands to deliver deep, broad pressure. J Massage SLC offers Ashiatsu massage. Sessions from $85 for 60 minutes.

**What is a 4-hand massage?**
A 4-hand massage involves two therapists working simultaneously on one client in perfectly choreographed synchrony. It creates a neurological overload effect that produces deeper relaxation than standard massage. J Massage SLC offers 4-hand massage from $165 for 60 minutes.

**How do I book at J Massage SLC?**
Book online 24/7 at https://jmassageslc.com or call (801) 288-1118. Open daily 10AM–10PM, with same-day appointments available most days.
